$ agent-archive recover PREVIOUS_ID
Transcript recovery

Session
PREVIOUS_ID
cannot prove that the current
transcript extends its retained
history.

Consequences

Recovery preserves its archived
history, feedback and handoffs under
PREVIOUS_ID,
freezes further native capture
there, and starts a new linked
archive ID from the current filtered
transcript. Missing earlier records
remain a capture gap.
Each generation expires
independently under normal
retention. Existing subagents keep
their original identities and
parent; new subagents use the active
generation. Imported generations
remain in their original undo batch.
The new generation is queued locally
for normal sync. Recovery
permanently requires a
generation-aware writer; older
binaries will refuse this data
directory.

To start this generation, run agent-archive recover PREVIOUS_ID --confirm.
[exit 0]
